Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The Zimbabwe players walk out. Bangladesh openers Sarkar and Naim follow. Raza to start. Here we go...

This is not going to be an easy chase! Yes, the wicket is good but Bangladesh have to bat really well, they do have the players but Zimbabwe have a decent bowling attack. All to play for then. Stay tuned.

The Bangladesh bowlers did not have the best of days out in the middle. Mohammad Saifuddin and Nasum Ahmed took a real pounding. Takin too who just bowled the two overs. Sarkar though was brilliant and if not for him, his side would have been chasing well over 200.

End of a brilliant batting effort from Zimbabwe! They maybe a little disappointed that they did not get over the 200-run mark but this is a really good tatal. It was the openers who laid the foundation with a 50-run stand. Regis Chakabva then came in and kept the momentum going. He smashed the bowlers all around the park and when he was batting, 200 plus looked certain. However, a few quiet overs in between and a few wickets pulled the hosts back. Burl though ensured they finished strongly and got above the 190-run mark.
Full ball, outside off. Ryan Burl slices it towards sweeper cover for a couple of runs. And Zimbabwe will finish the innings with 193 runs on the board.
Short ball, on leg stump. Ryan Burl ducks under it.
SIX! WOW! Good length ball, around off. Ryan heaves it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
FOUR! Another full toss, outside off. Ryan Burl smashes this over the mid off for a boundary this time.
Full toss again, Ryan Burl hits it towards mid-wicket for a couple. Good running by the batters.
Full toss, outside off. Ryan Burl slices it just over the mid off fielder for a couple of runs.

LEG BYE! Ryan Burl shuffles across to scoop this one. Gets hit on the body and the ball goes up in the air. The keeper runs and takes the catch. He appeals but the Umpire has given it as a Leg Bye. They take one.
Back of a length ball, outside off. Luke Jongwe pulls it awkwardly towards long for a single.
Swing and a Miss! Slower ball, outside off. Luke Jongwe looks to slog this one but misses it again. Crucial dot balls these for Bangladesh.
Slower short ball, around off. Luke Jongwe looks to pull hard but misses and gets hit on the body.
Slower ball, outside off. Luke Jongwe looks to cut but misses.
OUT! TAKEN! Bangladesh need to keep taking wickets here! This is a slower one on middle, Myers is early in the heave, it goes off the bottom towards deep square leg where an easy catch is taken.
Commentary.Howout: c Afif Hossain b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Full ball on leg. Ryan Burl hits it wide of the deep square leg fielder for another boundary.

FOUR! Misfield and Four. Good length ball, around off. Ryan Burl hits this wide of the long on fielder. Shakib Al Hasan in the deep fails to collect the ball cleanly and the ball goes past the ropes. Sloppy work this from the veteran.
Good length ball, outside off. Ryan Burl looks to slog but misses.
SIX! Short ball, a bit slower. Ryan Burl clears his front leg and heaves it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Good length ball, on off. Pulled hard towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Full ball, outside off. Dion Myers slices this one over the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Good length ball, on the stumps. Dragged towards the long on fielder for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length ball, on off. Dion Myers goes on the back foot to heave it and gets an inside edge which beats the keeper. The ball races away to the boundary.
Good length ball, outside off. Dion Myers looks to heave it but misses.
BYE! Slower ball, outside off. Deceived him completely. Ryan Burl misses and the keeper fails to collect it cleanly. They steal a single.
Short ball, got big on him. Dion Myers looks to pull but mistimes it just wide of the short fine leg fielder. They take one.
Slower ball, outisde off. Dion Myers slogs hard but inside edges it to the keeper.
Flatter ball, on off. Whipped towards the on side for a run.
Tossed up, on off. Tickled it towards short fine leg for a single.
Quicker ball, on off. Turned towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Flatter ball, on off. Flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Quicker ball, on off. Turned towards the leg side for one.

OUT! CAUGHT! Wesley Madhevere gets down on one knee and looks to reverse sweep it. Gets a top edge and the ball goes up in the air and it goes straight to the short third man fielder. Shoriful Islam takes an easy catch. And another set batter has to depart.
Commentary.Howout: c Shoriful Islam b Shakib Al Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: A dot to end! A bumper, the batter lets it go over him.
On middle, shorter, this is slapped down to long on for one more.
Shorter and on middle, Myers pulls it through square leg for one.
A dot! On off, this is slapped to covers.
FOUR! Really nicely played! Very nonchalant! On the pads, this is worked behind square on the leg side. Boundary.
On middle, this is pulled down to long on for one.
Shoriful Islam comes back into the attack.
Two dots to end soa  good comeback by the bowler. A slower one on middle, it is played back to the bowler.
Took him by surprise! A short one on the body, Myers is taken by surprise. Ducks under it at the very end.
On the pads, WM looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Another single! Cramping the batter for room by bowling it on the body, it is nudged through square leg for one more.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

EDGY FOUR! Fifty up for the opener! He has been solid! He has played the anchor role and done well so far. Needs to go on. This is full and outside off, Madhevere swings, this goes off the outside edge past the keeper and down to the third man fence.
A good over from Nasum! Another one on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Dealing in singles now! On middle, this is pushed down to long off for one more.
Wesley Madhevere misses out! A full toss on middle, this is heaved towards deep mid-wicket, not off the middle and only one.
Angled into the pads, Myers looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pad. It rolls on the leg side for one.
On middle, this is heaved through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one more.
Who will come out to bat next? Dion Myers is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Raza comes and Raza goes quickly! What an over this is from Sarkar, he has got Bangladesh back into the game. This lands on middle and then jags back in. Raza looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and then goes onto hit the stumps.
Outside off, this is lofted over covers for one.
Angled into the pads, Raza looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side for one.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Who will come out to bat? Sikandar Raza is the new man in.

OUT! That is a stunner! Wow! What a catch! Something special was needed to dismiss Regis Chakabva and Bangladesh have provided it. This is bowled full and outside off, Chakabva looks to drag it from there over the mid-wicket fence. It is the longer part of the ground. It goes high up in the air towards the fielder there. Naim in the deep takes it just ahead of the ropes but then is losing his balance. He then throws it over Hossain who runs to his right. He turns, runs back and takes it nicely. They go upstairs to check and it is a clean catch. Huge wicket. Can Bangladesh pull things back now?
Commentary.Howout: c Shamim Hossain b Soumya Sarkar

Commentary.Commentary: Just a single to end but the damage was done earlier! Really full and on middle, this is jammed down to long on for one.

SIX! Three in a row! He is taking the game away from Bangladesh! What a shot again. On middle, this is heaved over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Nasum Ahmed under huge pressure now. 20 from the over with a ball to go.
SIX! He has gone again and cleared the fence again! The 50-run stand is up and what a partnership this is. 41 out of the 50 has been from the bat of Chakabva.
SIX! That has been thumped! No stopping that! On middle, Chakabva brings out the slog sweep and nails it over mid-wicket. No stopping him here. He is striking at almost 200.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Flatter and on off, this is heaved through mid-wicket for one. He did not time it that well, it went more of the inner half.
Short and wide. Pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Right in the Blockhole. Regis Chakabva digs it out towards the off side.

Back of a length ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva agains looks to reverse sweep on the up but misses. The keeper collects the ball cleanly and whips the bails off in a flash. He appeals and the decision has been sent upstairs. The batter has been given the benefit of the doubt here as he grounded the bat exactly at the time when the bails were dislodged.
Good length ball, cramped him for room. Wesley Madhevere turns it on the leg side for a single.
A stumping appeal and it is taken upstairs! Bangladesh are celebrating.
WIDE! Way outside off. Wesley Madhevere leaves it alone.
Full ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva scoops this without timing towards short fine leg for a single.
SIX! Incredible stuff! Regis Chakabva has reverse swept this over third man region for a maximum. It was a good length ball, just outside off.
Sarkar is on now!
Tossed up, outside off. Regis Chakabva sweeps this to the deep sqaure leg fielder for one.
Quicker ball, outside off. Punched hard towards sweeper cover for one.
A tad short, on leg. Worked behind short fine leg for a couple of runs.
Quicker ball, on off. Punched towards long off for one.
Tossed up, on off. Regis Chakabva slog sweeps this time to the deep mid-wicket fielder.
SIX! Short and outside off. Regis Chakabva pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Quicker ball, on off. Flicked towards wide long on for a single.
SIX! WOW! Regis Chakabva has reverse swept this for a maximum. It was tossed up, on off. He really nailed that, got height on it and the distance.
Tossed up, on off. Whipped towards long on for one.
Tossed up, on off. Driven towards long off for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva looks to cut but misses.
Flatter ball, outside off. Punched towards long off for one.
Short ball, on off. Pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
In the air, but safe. Regis Chakabva pushes this quicker ball towards long on for one. The fielder dives but it was too far from him.
Quicker ball, on off. Regis Chakabva pushes it uppishly towards short mid-wicket.
Short ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere pulls it towards long on for one.
Flatter ball, on middle. Flicked towards sqaure leg for a run.
Quicker ball, on off. Turned towards the on side for one.
Regis Chakabva walks out to bat!

OUT! Cleaned him up! Length ball, angling in slightly. Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to heave it on the leg side but misses. The ball goes through his bat and pad and crashes onto the stumps. Bangladesh get the breakthrough finally.
Full ball, on off. Driven towards cover for a run. Excellent diving stop there by Soumya Sarkar. They take one.
Good length ball, on off. Tadiwanashe Marumani inside edges this on the pads. The ball rolls onto the leg side and they take one.
SIX! Good length ball and Tadiwanashe Marumani comes down the track and heaves it on the on side for a maximum.
FOUR LEG BYES! Full ball, strayed on the pads. Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to flick and gets rapped on the pads and the ball goes past the keeper for a boundary.
Low full toss, on the pads. Pushed back at the bowler.
Misses out! A dot to end. On middle, shorter. This is pulled but to square leg. That was a chance to hit a boundary.
Takes one now as this is worked to mid-wicket.
Another dot! On off, this is pushed to the man at covers.
Steps down the track but Shakib shortens the length. It is defended.
Another one and the 50 is up! Angled into the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for one. Perfect start for them.
Slower and shorter and on off, this is dragged down to long on for one.
Good length ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere looks to slog hard bit misses this time. WOW! What an over this was!
FOUR! Simply Superb! Full ball, on off. Wesley Madhevere drives it back past the bowler for a boundary. And that is 5 boundaries in 5 consecutive balls. He means Business.
FOUR! Back of a length ball, on off. Wesley Madhevere pulls it towards deep sqaure leg for another boundary. And he is on FIRE!
FOUR! Half volley on off. Wesley Madhevere drives it straight down the ground this time. He is looking dangerous.
FOUR! WOW! Cracking shot this! Back of a length ball, outside off. Pullled towards mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! Good length ball, on leg. Wesley Madhevere heaves it towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! This is slammed! Marumani uses his feet, this is shortish but not as short as the last two, it is slapped over mid on for another boundary.
FOUR! Up and over the keeper! Fortunate boundary! Shorter and on middle, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to pull, it goes off the top edge and over the keeper for a boundary.
Another short one and outside off, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to pull but misses again.
Short and outside off, TM looks to pull but misses.
Another short one, this one is quick! Wesley is late in the pull, it hits the glove and lobs towards short fine leg, lands short so one.
Just over! A short one and on middle, this batter looks to pull, this goes off the toe-end over mid-wicket for two.
Shoriful Islam comes into the attack.

That is brilliant from Afif! Saves a run for his side! This is full and on the pads, this is worked through backward square leg. It is the longer part of the ground. Afif in the deep, runs to his right, slides and pushes it back in. A run saved. This is a good start for the hosts.
Nicely played! This is fuller and on the pads, this is worked wide of the fielder at long on for two.
Quick run! Shorter and outside off, Marumani guides it towards point for one.
A yorker on middle, this is jammed back to the bowler.
Almost! An in-dipping yorker, this one tails back in from outside off. Sneaks under the bat of the batter who looks to drive but does not hit the stumps.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off for one.
Mohammad Saifuddin to start from the other end.
The physio is out! There is a slight halt in play as Tadiwanashe Marumani has been hit on the helmet. A new helmet has been brought in.
That is nasty! A short one and on middle, Marumani ducks under it. This one does not bounce a lot and hits him flush no the helmet. He looks fine though. A dot to end but a good start for Zimbabwe.

FOUR! Up and over! First boundary of the game! Probably not where he intended but he won't care! Fuller and around off, the batter looks to go over covers but the bat probably twists in his hands, he slices it over point but this one trickles away to the fence.
Good shot but just for one! On a length and around off, this is stroked on the up towards cover. The fielder fumbles and a single is taken.
That is a beauty! Taskin goes wide of the crease and angles it into the off pole, this lands and then moves away. Whizzes past the outside edge as Wesley Madhevere is beaten.
Again! Looks to hit the ball a little too hard here! It is shorter and on off, Marumani pulls it hard through square leg for one. He really looked to hit that hard and hence, did not get the timing.

In the air... safe! A positive start from the hosts! Tadiwanashe Marumani comes down the track and this is bowled shorter and on middle, Marumani has a whack across the line, it goes more off the splice but lands safe behind mid-wicket for two. Zimbabwe and the opener are underway.
The players are on the field. Tadiwanashe Marumani and Wesley Madhevere are on the crease. Taskin Ahmed to start with the bowl.

Mahmudullah, Bangladesh Captain says he is happy with bowling first and they want to restrict them to as low as possible. States they want to improve on the chances they missed. Mentions you just need a couple of batters to click in a T20 game and that should do the job for their side. Reckons the bowlers have been really good and he is looking forward to a good game.

Sikandar Raza, Zimbabwe Captain says they want to play with absolute freedom and it is a great quality if they can bat first and defend the total. States the wicket looks good and it should be another cracker of a game. Adds he always try to improve on their mistakes and they just try to be better than the last time they played.

PITCH REPORT - The sun is out but it is pretty chilly. The pitch has been used twice in the series before. There is a little bit of grass but it won't be assisting the seamers or the spinners and it should be a good pitch to bat on.

Wellington Masakadza is down for a chat. He says it was a good day for him, he was happy with the wickets and the ball kept following him in the field. States bowling into the wicket was part of the plan as there was variable bounce and bowling into the wicket was the plan. Adds as a spinner bowling in the middle overs is what they do the most but bowling in the Powerplay is not bad. Ends by saying everyone is in a good space and he feels they are on the right path to win the game.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Mohammad Naim, Soumya Sarkar, Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Nurul Hasan (WK), Shamim Hossain, Nasum Ahmed (COMES IN FOR Mahedi Hasan), Mohammad Saifuddin, Taskin Ahmed, Shoriful Islam.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Tadiwanashe Marumani (WK), Wesley Madhevere, Regis Chakabva, Dion Myers, Sikandar Raza (C), Ryan Burl, Luke Jongwe, Milton Shumba, Wellington Masakadza, Blessing Muzarabani, Tendai Chatara.
TOSS - Zimbabwe have won the flip of the coin and THEY WILL BAT FIRST!

It is time for the decider! A spirited show from the hosts saw them level the series and bag their first win of the this tour! They will surely be high on confidence and hungry to end the tour on a high by winning the T20I series. Bangladesh on the other hand, will also be wanting to get back to winning ways. They won the one-off Test, the ODI series and now will be wanting to win the T20I series too. All to play for then. Welcome to the coverage. Stay tuned for the toss in a while.
